column1: Feedback
<mafia-boss> told you that you need to make some more money for the Family or you might get <whacked/clipped/popped>.
<mafia-boss> told you to step up your game or you'll soon be out.
<mafia-boss> said you better not be holding out on the Family, cuz there's no way you made this little.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that being in the Family is costly; you better start paying up.
<mafia-boss> is asking if you need to be taught a lesson about making money for the Family.
<mafia-boss> warned that if you didn't start making money, it would literally cost you an arm and a leg.
<mafia-boss> took you aside and taught you a lesson in mob economics: if money doesn't come in, you don't make it out.
<mafia-boss> said that if you don't start pulling your weight, you'll find yourself sinking, never to resurface.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that the Family isn't a charity; they always collect what is owed them.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that this life ain't free; everything has a price. Especially laziness.
<mafia-boss> asked why you aren't appreciative of the opportunity the Family has given you, then reminded you that ungratefulness leads to a life cut short.
<mafia-boss> asked if you had a little extra cash tucked away, because your contribution to the Family's funds has been scant.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that the Family always gets its due, in one way or another.
<mafia-boss> asked if you have a hole in your pocket that needs to be stitched up.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that this is the Family's world, you're just renting space, and payment is due.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that cash equals credibility. Without either, you're expendable.
<mafia-boss> reminded you this life is a full-time job--one you don't want to get fired from.
<mafia-boss> told you that you don't want to keep attracting the wrong kind of attention from the higher-ups. It could be deadly.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that the Family doesn't like feeling underappreciated and underpaid.
<mafia-boss> said you need to stop making a mockery of the Family's name.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that the Family doesn't employ mooches. Earn your place, or someone's gonna dig one for you.
<mafia-boss> stared at you, then looked at your contribution to the Family, and asked if <he/she> looked like a punk to you.
<mafia-boss> said you need to make it rain to get yourself out of the hole your laziness dug.
<mafia-boss> said what little money you have brought in for the Family proves how expendable you are.
<mafia-boss> said your earnings are insufficient to cover your continuing existence in the Family, and if things don't change soon, you'll cease to exist.
<mafia-boss> says what little money you have earned for the Family has put you in a debtor's position, and it's a deadly position to be in.
<mafia-boss> said the money you have earned is as insignificant to the Family as you are.
<mafia-boss> said if you don't step-up your earnings, you'll be stepping into a pair of cement boots.
<mafia-boss> said the lack of assets you have contributed to the Family is making you a liability.
<mafia-boss> said your contribution to the Family balance sheet is already underwater, and if things don't change soon, you'll be underwater too.
<mafia-boss> said your lack of earnings indicates that you might be in for an early 'retirement'.
<mafia-boss> said if you don't inject some <caffeine/stimulants> into your earnings soon, you could easily fall into the big sleep.
<mafia-boss> said if you thought your contributions to the Family were sufficient, you're dead wrong.
<mafia-boss> said your contributions to the Family are <insulting/offensive>.
<mafia-boss> reminded you that members who don't contribute to the Family are the first to get dismembered.
